KEN.note: States no rule or authority on AI harms; reports a parliamentary finding on a health claims system.
The AI named sits in the health insurance claims system, a sector system, not general administration.

facts.fact: The Health Committee's report tabled in Parliament says the Social Health Authority's AI-driven claims processing system is in use and rejects some legitimate hospital claims as fraudulent.
Health CS Aden Duale said investigations had uncovered irregular payments of Sh10.6 billion, credited to new safeguards embedded in the SHA system.
